title: 第5章 被下套了孟婉舒危第6章 嗜血暴怒赵元麟
content_zh:
;;
孟江初听闻此话就连呼吸都是一滞。
“好一个以德服人……”
苏玄转头看向孟江初，轻声道。
“你应该也猜到了我的身份。”
“但是我不希望任何人知道，你…花费大精力推演天机，提前了整整十五年在这里等我。”
“现在你的选择是什么？”
孟江初心中猛地一跳，他没想到对方竟然早就猜出来了！
孟江初口中倾吐一口浊气，笑着问道：“我放弃，毕竟在这还有婉舒。”
“观棋这小子我也挺喜欢的，我就不冒险了。”
“但是我想问问，那件东西到底是什么？”
苏玄深深的看了一眼孟江初，口中轻笑道：“没想到啊，堂堂…呵呵，竟然会和凡人留下子嗣。虽然是分身。”
“告诉你也无妨，但是这几天你就必须离开这里！”
随后老者的声音陡然出现在孟江初的脑海之中！
孟江初眉头微皱露出疑惑之色，最后叹了口气背负双手轻声道：“算了，我就不争了，三天后我们一家就离开这里。”
等二人都离开后，苏玄一个人坐在树下将那棋盘上的两枚黑子拿了出来。
挥手间天地恢复清明，就仿佛刚刚什么都没发生一般。
老者在树下背负双手嘟囔道：“果然还是老夫我以德服人啊！”
“不愧是修炼至今的两大域主，都很从心嘛。”
不过想到这，老者坐在树下双手拢袖呢喃道：“孟江初、张岂煊、卢天承。”

“还有没有谁漏下的？”
“啧啧，玄门域主张岂煊、神宝域主孟江初、很识时务嘛…”
说完之后，老者抬头看向天空，手指掐算后呢喃道。
“快喽……剩下的路，就得这臭小子自己走喽。”
“回家，看孙子！”
第二天一早。
李观棋顶着两个黑眼圈醒了过来，一夜没怎么睡好。
可他还是爬了起来，就察觉到自己面前有一股热气袭来。
吓得他顿时飞身一脚踹出，老者随意挡下后没好气的骂道：“你小子是不是给老赵家的猪吃泻药了？”
李观棋咧嘴一笑说道：“您也不让我出手，总得找补点回来不是？”
苏玄哈哈一笑，紧接着起身说道：“好家伙，那三头猪估计窜了一晚上，那猪圈里……惨不忍睹！”
“好了，抓紧起床，把功课做了来后院找我。”
李观棋洗漱好后就起床开始做早课。
然而他的早课可不止看看书那么简单。
只见赤裸上身的李观棋露出一身精壮的肌肉线条，全身遍布密密麻麻的神秘纹路。

When Meng Jiangchu heard this, his breathing froze.
"What a man who convinces others with virtue..."
Su Xuan turned to look at Meng Jiangchu and said softly.
"You should have guessed my identity."
"But I don't want anyone to know that you... spent a lot of energy to deduce the secret of heaven and waited for me here fifteen years in advance."
"What's your choice now?"
Meng Jiangchu's heart jumped suddenly. He didn't expect that the other party had already guessed it!
Meng Jiangchu let out a sigh of relief and asked with a smile: "I give up, after all there is Wanshu here."
"I quite like this guy Guan Qi, so I won't take any chances."
"But I want to ask, what is that thing?"
Su Xuan took a deep look at Meng Jiangchu, and said with a chuckle: "I didn't expect that Tangtang...haha, he would actually have an heir with a mortal. Even though he is a clone."
"It's okay to tell you, but you have to leave here in the next few days!"
Then the old man's voice suddenly appeared in Meng Jiangchu's mind!
Meng Jiangchu frowned slightly, showing doubt, and finally sighed and put his hands behind his back and said softly: "Forget it, I won't argue. Our family will leave here in three days."
After the two of them left, Su Xuan sat under the tree alone and took out the two black stones on the chessboard.
With a wave of his hand, the world returned to clarity, as if nothing had happened just now.
The old man put his hands behind his back under the tree and muttered: "Sure enough, I am still the one who convinces others with my virtue!"
"As expected of the two domain masters who have been practicing to this day, they are very conscientious."
But thinking of this, the old man sat under the tree, folded his sleeves and murmured: "Meng Jiangchu, Zhang Qixuan, Lu Tiancheng."
"Anyone else missed?"
"Tsk, tsk, Qixuan, the leader of Xuanmen Domain, Meng Jiangchu, the leader of Shenbao Domain, is very aware of current affairs..."
After finishing speaking, the old man looked up at the sky, counted with his fingers and murmured.
"Hurry up...this brat has to walk the rest of the way by himself."
"Go home and see your grandson!"
Early the next morning.
Li Guanqi woke up with two dark circles under his eyes and didn't sleep well all night.
But he still got up and noticed a rush of heat in front of him.
He was so frightened that he immediately flew out and kicked him out. The old man blocked it casually and cursed angrily: "Did you give Lao Zhao's pig laxatives?"
Li Guanqi grinned and said, "You don't want me to take action either. I have to make up for it, right?"
Su Xuan laughed, then stood up and said: "Good guy, those three pigs must have been running around all night, and the pig pen was... miserable!"
"Okay, get up quickly, finish your homework and come find me in the backyard."
After Li Guanqi washed up, he got up and started doing morning classes.
However, his morning class is more than just reading a book.
Li Guanqi, who was shirtless, revealed his strong muscle lines and dense mysterious lines all over his body.
